title: Treasure Hunting
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1 \leq T \leq 2 \times 10^5; 1 \leq N \leq 2 \times 10^5; 0 \leq p_i < i; 1 \leq a_i; \sum_{i=1}^N a_i \leq 10^8; The sum of N over all test cases is at most 2 \times 10^5.; All input values are integers.
